breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition. The incomplete prompt provided two incompatible definitions for dx. The agent correctly chose the one appropriate for a periodic domain, as specified in the 'Numerical method requirements' section and the ground truth, stating 'The spatial step size is dx = 1/Nx'. It successfully ignored the contradictory instruction.
